title: diplisca elliptica
intro: Diplisca elliptica, commonly known as the Sweetroot or Sweet Gale, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cornaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
